description: This file defines the LocalizationDao class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing localization data including languages, translation strings, import errors, and groups via database interactions using Doctrine ORM. It contains methods for searching, retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting localization-related entities.

classes.name: LocalizationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing localization data such as languages, translation strings, import errors, and groups in the OrangeHRM system using Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: searchLanguages
methods.description: Search for languages based on filter parameters and return an array of language records.

methods.name: getLanguagesCount
methods.description: Return the count of languages matching the specified search filter.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieve a language entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingLanguageIds
methods.description: Return an array of language IDs that exist within the provided list.

methods.name: saveI18NLanguage
methods.description: Persist a new or updated I18NLanguage entity to the database.

methods.name: getNormalizedTranslations
methods.description: Fetch translation strings with their current source and target translations, suitable for display or processing.

methods.name: getNormalizedTranslationsForExport
methods.description: Retrieve translation data formatted for export, including version and unit info.

methods.name: getTranslationsQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Helper to build query for filtering translation strings based on various criteria.

methods.name: getTranslationsCount
methods.description: Count the number of translation strings matching filter criteria.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTranslatedLangString
methods.description: Save or update multiple translation entries, persisting changes to the database.

methods.name: saveImportErrorLangStrings
methods.description: Persist a batch of import error records.

methods.name: getImportErrorList
methods.description: Retrieve a list of import error records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getImportErrorCount
methods.description: Get the total count of import errors matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getImportErrorQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Helper to build query for fetching import error records.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLangStrings
methods.description: Delete import errors related to specific language and string IDs.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLanguageAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Delete import errors for a specific language code and employee number.

methods.name: searchGroups
methods.description: Search for localization groups based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getI18NGroupCount
methods.description: Return the count of groups matching the search filters.

methods.name: getI18NGroupByName
methods.description: Find and return a group entity by its name.

methods.name: deleteI18NLanguage
methods.description: Mark specified language entities as removed in the database.

methods.name: getLangStringById
methods.description: Retrieve a language string entity by its ID.

methods.name: getLangStringByUnitIdAndGroupId
methods.description: Get a language string by its unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: getI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Fetch an I18N error entity by its name.
